body:
Plan, rules and numbers: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2.md (read "How a section is bound" first). Worktree wf-docs2, branch docs/pass2; DOCS_COMMON.md applies. Per-section list: wf-context/docs-gaps/pass2/out-before/binding-sections.md.

Rules in short: bind claims, not mentions. For each target section, cite the code its claims depend on: `pass2/dsdef.sh <file>#<Symbol> [stable|api]` prints the id (idempotent, writes `//ds:def` in this repo's style), then link the name in the sentence: [`Name`](ds:block?id=<id>). Defaults and limits cite their const. Pitfalls that state library or driver behaviour cite the code (or the test) that makes it true. Snippet-synced Go blocks stay with `task docs:snippets`; bind the prose around them. Only `//ds:def` lines may change in library files. Never run `ds scan`, `ds ack` or `ds refresh` (the coordinator scans and commits `.ds/` once at the end); `ds check` must stay at 0 errors.

Owns: `docs/jobs/`, `docs/concepts/`, `docs/middleware/`; examples: accelerator-queue, capabilities, client-wrapper, closures, concurrency, deferred-dispatch, delayed-jobs, edit-run, functions, http-status, idempotency, job-guards, manage-runs, message-attributes, middleware-stack, named-queues, push-delivery, queue-guards, queue-limit, queue-weights, release-errors, results-progress, retries, retry-limits, route-jobs, run-control, run-inline, run-reschedule, run-states, run-transitions, snooze-heartbeat, step-events, step-middleware, step-slots, task-output, tenant-spans, trigger-source, typed-payloads, upstream-limits.

Binding now: 36 pages, 247 sections describe library code (Try it and Related excluded), 18 bound.

## Gaps to close

- [x] No open gap rows. Cite instead of typing: `DefaultStreamBuffer`, `DefaultStreamMaxChunk`, `DefaultStreamMaxRunBytes`, `DefaultStreamMaxRunChunks`, `DefaultStreamMaxRuns`, `DefaultStreamRetain`, `DefaultStreamTTL` (jobs/http-start.md), `middleware.DefaultPoolRetry`, `middleware.FireJitterNeeds`, `InlineResult` (run-inline.md); no page names these yet.
- [x] Every 'which drivers have it' sentence (Before you start) cites the driver capability defs (run `dsdef.sh` on each driver's capability list; idempotent, W3 may have made them already).

## Done when

- [x] `python3 tools/binding.py` + `tools/batches.py` (see pass2.md) show every target section of this batch bound, or the report names the section and why it states no claim worth binding.
- [x] `ds check` 0 errors; `task docs:wrap docs:links docs:snippets docs:words` pass; `go test -race` of every example touched.
- [x] Report wf-context/reports/docs-docs2-w2.md (named after the session docs2-w2; was docs-p2-w2.md) with before/after binding counts, defs added (id, file), Shared-file lines, Library bugs, DONE.
